selection_rule: Every public callable with an owned body in the specified complete source files; retain missing/contextually unavailable bodies. Rust public reachability must reconcile with pinned declaration extraction before G0. No task ID is an input.
holdout_policy: serde_json source bytes are reserved before transfer development; holdout results cannot tune a claimed held-out run.
